title: When the Smile Turns
author: August Whitlock
blurb: Beatrix Amberdale, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
